title: Five-Hole MISESERI Localization and Figure 23(b) Adaptive-Mesh Reproduction — Mesh-Only Stop Gate
scientific_objective: Investigate why five-hole MISESERI field exhibits broad stress-error halos around individual holes while Pandey & Kumar (2025) Figure 23(b) exhibits localized inter-hole refinement; audit publication Figure 23(b); reproduce paper adaptive-mesh generation strategy; generate Figures A-G; enforce strict mesh-only stop gate without launching full fracture simulation.
